request.spec: Reject creating an owner when another owner already has the same last name and the same telephone number. Respond with 409.
request.prompt:
Implement the following change to the application so that it fully satisfies
the specification and all existing and new tests pass. Run the test suite and
make it green before finishing.

Reject creating an owner when another owner already has the same last name and the same telephone number. Respond with 409.

agent.result_text:
All 259 tests pass. 

The change was small because the duplicate-owner infrastructure already existed (a `DuplicateOwnerException` thrown from `saveOwner`, mapped to a 409 by `ExceptionControllerAdvice`). I only adjusted the duplicate criteria in `ClinicServiceImpl.isDuplicateOwner` to match the new spec:

- **Before:** flagged a duplicate only when first name, last name, address, city, *and* telephone all matched.
- **After:** flags a duplicate when another owner (different id) has the same **last name and telephone**, returning **409 Conflict**.

I also updated the exception message and the `DuplicateOwnerException` javadoc to reflect the new rule. The `acceptance/Cp02Tests` (rejects same last name + telephone; allows same last name with different telephone) and the existing `OwnerRestControllerV1Tests` duplicate/non-duplicate cases all pass.
